Danish vs Madhyapradesh Shasan Dwara Khadya Evam ... on 3
May, 2024
Author: Prem Narayan Singh

Bench: Prem Narayan Singh
In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Indore Crr No. 1851 of 2024 (Danish And
Others Vs Madhyapradesh Shasan Dwara Khadya Evam Aushadhi Prashasan
And Others) Dated : 03-05-2024 Shri Manish Kumar Vijaywargiya, learned counsel for the
Petitioner .
Shri Prashant Jain appearing on behalf of Advocate General.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Madhyapradesh Shasan Dwara Khadya Evam Aushadhi Prashasan
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: Heard on IA No. 6225 of 2024, which is an application filed under Section 397(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure for suspension of jail sentence and grant of bail on behalf of petitioner.
2. The petitioner has been convicted under Section 7(ii) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, r/w Section 16(1)(A)(i) and sentenced to undergo for 6 months RI with fine of default stipulation.
3 . Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in this case.
In support of his contention counsel placed reliance upon the judgment passed by Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of A.K. Sarkar and Co. and Another Vs. State of West Bengal and others.

entities.text: A.K. Sarkar and Co. and Another Vs. State of West Bengal and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: reported in (2024) 3 S.C.R. 356 AND Trilok Chand Vs. State of Himachal Pradesh reported in (2020) 10 SCC 763.

entities.text: Trilok Chand Vs. State of Himachal Pradesh reported in (2020) 10 SCC 763
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The trial will take considerable time for its disposal, hence,
he prays that the petitioner may be released on bail.
4 . On due consideration of the submissions made on behalf of the petitioner, it would be appropriate to suspend the jail sentence of the petitioner.

5. Accordingly, IA No. 6225 of 2024 filed on behalf of petitioner is allowed subject to depositing the fine amount as well as on furnishing personal bond by petitioner in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court, for his regular appearance before the registry of this Court, the execution of custodial part of the remaining sentence imposed against the petitioner shall remain suspended, till the final disposal of this petition.

6. The petitioner, after being enlarged on bail, shall mark his presence before the registry of this Court on 24.10.2024 and on all such subsequent dates, which are fixed by the registry in this regard.

(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE VD Danish vs Madhyapradesh Shasan Dwara Khadya Evam ... on 3 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104505301/
